intro: Tazan's Satchel is a locked pouch carried by the troll Tazan, who operates alongside pirates near Ratchet. It holds secret information coveted by the Shattered Hand, the covert guild of rogues based beneath Orgrimmar.

p: Within the sun-baked wastes of the Barrens, a troll named Tazan carries on illicit dealings with the pirates encamped along the coast near Ratchet. These under-the-table arrangements drew the keen eyes of Therzok, a guild master of the Shattered Hand situated in the subterranean gloom of the Cleft of Shadow. Seeking to build covert power away from Warchief Thrall's cautious diplomacy, the Shattered Hand marked Tazan for elimination to seize the valuable intelligence bound within his satchel.
